title: Bump konva from 10.3.1 to 10.3.2
intent: Dependabot runtime-dependency patch bump. konva is the 2D canvas library behind the CAM and lutherie drawing surfaces, so unlike the dev-tooling bumps in this batch it does ship to users. No application code changes and no engine-floor change.

diff_articulation.what_changed: dependency konva ^10.3.1 -> ^10.3.2. The lockfile change is the single version/resolved/integrity triple for konva itself; no transitive package is added, removed, re-parented, or re-versioned, and the package count is unchanged at 431.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: This manifest exists because the gate had been borrowing an unrelated one. Auto-discovery selected .cbsp21/patches/dep-sec-pr281-types-node.json — the manifest for PR #281's @types/node bump — which happens to declare both files this PR touches and therefore scored 100%. The gate was green on coincidence rather than on a declaration about this change. A per-PR manifest replaces that.

commands_run: Blast radius stated rather than glossed: konva is in dependencies (not devDependencies) and is imported by 9 client source files — useExportDxf.ts, useKonvaCanvas.ts, useWoodGrain.ts, drawCamOverlay.ts, NeckView.vue, and four views under views/cam/headstock/. This ships to users, so it carries more risk than the dev-tooling bumps in the same batch, though it is a patch release.

Four of those nine importers are in views/cam/headstock/, which is a known-orphaned directory carrying part of the standing vue-tsc error set. Those files are the least-exercised consumers; the load-bearing ones are the composables and NeckView.

Type-check ratchet is unmoved: the lint-build run for this PR reports 'vue-tsc errors: 150 | baseline ceiling: 150', so the new konva typings introduce no diagnostic change across those 9 importers. The ratchet sits AT its ceiling with zero headroom, so this is a meaningful signal rather than a formality.

Engine floor unaffected: reproduced nodeEngineFloor.spec.ts's dependenciesAboveTheFloor() logic over the PR lockfile — every non-optional package's engines.node is covered by a lane of the declared floor '^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0'. Zero offenders, identical to main. Unlike #347, this bump forces no floor change.
Lockfile reviewed in full (4 +/-): konva's version, resolved URL and integrity hash only.
CI observed running Node 22.23.2, which satisfies the declared floor.

files.intent: Bump the konva dependency range to ^10.3.2.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Runtime dependency patch bump with no transitive movement, no API or schema change, no engine-floor change, and no movement in the type-check ratchet. Recorded as shipping code rather than tooling so a reviewer weighs it accordingly.

no_backend_no_schema: No backend API, route, schema, persistence, workflow, or build change. The change is confined to the client's canvas rendering dependency.
